notes.title: What's Happening in Feudal Castle ?
notes.content:
After an intensive bug fixing process, Feudal Friends is back!
We will continue to actively improve and update Feudal Friends. Therefore, every bug you report is very important for us and the development of Feudal Friends. 
Join our Discord community to report bugs and meet others who play Feudal Friends and play games together!

Let's take a look at the changes;

Improvements

 Lobby UI update.
 Voice chat system added, in lobby and gameplay!
 Text chat system added. In lobby and gameplay!
 Random lobby finding system has been added, so you can match with random players.
 The posters in the market have been renewed!
 In-game UI has been renewed!
 Castle lighting, shading updated.
 Item materials updated.
 Leaderboard ranking added.
 The designs of decision gates have been renewed.



Fixes

 Controls system updated.
 Castle sounds bug fixed.
 Crash issues in the tutorial game have been fixed.
 Controller support bugs have been fixed.
 Buy Menu bugs fixed.
 Controller UI navigation system changed. Now more stable.
 FPS drops with the player controller have been fixed!
 Fixed over 100 bugs that caused problems such as crashes and freezing.



Join our Discord community,
https://discord.gg/feudalfriends

Thank you for all again,

Keep Games

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2317820/Feudal_Friends/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

notes.title: HOT FIX ANNOUNCEMENT !! 🔥🛠
notes.content:
Dear Feudal Friends,

Since the moment we released our game, we’ve been keeping an eye on your feedback.

We enjoy updating and improving the gameplay experience of Feudal Friends, mostly when you let us know about things you don't like. Here are the most common bugs we've heard about and fixed in the first 48 hours;


 Key binding feature added. 
 2v1 Game mode blocked.
 In-game economy improved. 
 Mortar strengthened.
 Optimization issues improved.


We are grateful for all your feedback on how we can improve Feudal Friends, and we are actively pursuing it on our social channels. 

Please also do not forget to join our Discord so we can build a fun community together by playing Feudal Friends and various games.
#LetsPlayFF
Discord Community

notes.title: Release Date Announcement! 🔥
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,
Feudal Friends will be with you on July 17 at 18:00 UTC🎉
Thanks to everyone who has been supporting the game and playing the demo. Your feedback, reports and suggestions have been incredibly valuable and it's been amazing to see all your comments! 


Fixes and features for Launch after Demo version;

Features; 

 Mortar(the ballista on the castle has been replaced.)
 Runes bugs fixed
 Added resolution settings. 
 Added quality settings. 
 Added castle repair scenario to training.

Twitch Integration
With the release, we've added Twitch integration to the game. 
Streamers playing Feudal Friends can have their chat participants type !attack in the chat during their streams to see their nicknames in the battlefield, and they can influence the decision gates affecting the streamers' game.
You can link the Bits you received during the stream to the game. You can find more information about how this can be set up here.

Fixes/Other;


 Collider Bugs
 Tutorial Stages Crash&Bugs
 Tutorial Chat Box Improvements
 Controller Support Improvements
 Battle Area Visual Improvements
 Visual Bugs Of Siege Weapon Stages
 Custom Lobby Bugs
 All missing gamepad support has been fixed.
 Language bugs fixed. 
 Optimization issues fixed. 
 Improved Buy menu visuals.
 Repair hammer power updated
 Minions Battle Scenarios 
 Fixed lobby bugs
 More than 25 minor Visual & Mechanical bugs fixed.


Following an intense bug fixing period, we will continue to update our game with the release. Therefore, every bug you report is very important for us and the development of Feudal Friends.

Join our Discord community,
https://discord.gg/feudalfriends

Thank you for all again,
